answer: Commit-reveal bond: an agent hashes its voyage plan, locks 70 credits. An ember seal tags it; the plan stays sealed until reveal, when the registry checks it — a mismatch forfeits it. Reveals enter the meadow log; reused seals are caught. Filing 30, k-th 30+6(k-1): a thousand fakes pay 3,027,000 and tie up 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented commits fail: bought reveals match no fresh hash. An honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its bond.
